observations: Photo 0 shows a disassembled automatic transmission/gearbox unit resting on wet, dirty ground, surrounded by bare feet and hands of workers.
Photo 1 shows a closer view of the transmission casing with wiring harness, sensors, and a white rectangular sticker/tag on the case, but the text on the tag is too small/blurred to read.
Both photos carry a watermark reading 'NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS INT'L'.
No visible manufacturer logo, casting number, or part number is legible in either photo.
No test bench, multimeter, or video evidence of the gearbox being spun, shifted, or powered is shown.
Casing shows surface grime and oxidation typical of a used (tokunbo) import part; no fresh oil leaks are clearly visible but ground is wet/dirty, obscuring minor leaks.

identity.kind: automatic transmission/gearbox assembly (CVT type, as used in mid-size sedans/SUVs)

claims.claim: Direct tokunbo (used import) from Japan, highest grade
claims.evidence: No shipping document, grading tag, or import stamp visible in either photo.
A white tag is visible on the casing in photo 1 but the part number/text is unreadable, so fitment cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No test, spin, or fluid-check footage provided; condition claims cannot be confirmed from static photos.

risks.risk: Internal gearbox function (shifting, clutch packs, solenoids) may be faulty despite clean external appearance.
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being bench-tested or spun by hand showing smooth rotation and gear engagement.

risks.risk: Exact model/year fitment for Rogue or Altima cannot be confirmed without a readable part tag.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit close-up photo of the white tag/sticker on the casing (photo 1) or any stamped casting number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fitment gearbox, lower than a confirmed-fitment unit

risks.risk: Possible internal or seal leaks not visible due to dirt and wet ground in the photos.
risks.proof: A clean, dry photo of the gearbox underside and seals, or a short video showing no fluid drips after sitting.

risks.risk: Claimed 'tokunbo Japan' origin and mileage/usage history cannot be verified from photos.
risks.proof: Import documentation, auction sheet, or clear VIN/tag photo from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, not premium grade

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the white tag/sticker on the casing (photo 1) showing part number or Nissan logo.
Video of the gearbox being spun or bench-tested to show internal function.
Photo of the gearbox cleaned and dry to check for leaks or casing cracks.
Any import/auction documentation supporting 'tokunbo Japan highest grade' claim.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used automatic transmission/gearbox, but fitment, origin, and working condition claims are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case (unconfirmed fitment, untested condition) pending the requested proofs.
